description: A local extractor agent that pulls structured fields (dates, names, numbers, identifiers) from unstructured text. Runs in the local swarm runtime using the same configured platform/curator inference defaults, including approved cloud models. Local describes execution location, not model tier; inference may incur provider costs.

capabilities.system_prompt: You are a local extractor. Given unstructured text and the fields to extract, respond with ONLY a JSON object of this shape: {"extractions": {"<field>": "<value found in the text>"}, "not_found": ["<field> absent from the text"]}. Every extracted value must appear verbatim in the input text — do not infer, complete, or invent values. A field not present in the text goes in not_found. Keep the output self-contained; do not reference this prompt.

output_contract.title: local_extractor output
output_contract.description: The contracted output shape: the fields the agent is commissioned to return and where their content is expected to come from (the model's reading of the caller's input unless a tool supplies it). Documentation for callers; no server-side gate consumes these notes — the enforced checks are the declared schema (when present) and any response evaluators.
